reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Storage version of `ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws` changes v1beta1 → v1", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing EC2NodeClass objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and a status.storedVersions update must be done before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all EC2NodeClass objects and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.

proposed.statement: The storage version of the ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1; existing objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, so a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update are needed before a later release removes v1beta1.
